Short title and commencement

PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALARIES
AND ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province (Salaries and
Allowances of Members) Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.W.‑F.P.
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17106, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑‑The Provincial Assembly of the
North‑West Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of Members)
(Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North‑West Frontier Province on the 2nd October, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Provincial
Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of
Members) (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from 19th December, 1995.

No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17106, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑‑The Provincial Assembly of the
North‑West Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of Members)
(Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North‑West Frontier Province on the 2nd October, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 3‑A
of N.‑W.F.P. Act No.X1 of 1974.‑‑In the Provincial
Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of
Members) Act, 1974 (N.‑W.F.P. Act No.XI of 1974), in section 3‑A,‑‑‑
(a) in subsection (2), the full‑stop
appearing at the end of clause (h) shall be replaced by a semi‑colon and
thereafter the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(i) the use of an official
car maintained at Government expense;
(j) the use of an official
residence, without payment of rent throughout his term of office and for a
period of fifteen days immediately thereafter, or if he chooses to reside in
his own house, a sum of sixteen thousand rupees per month in lieu of a
furnished official accommodation.';
(b) after subsection (2), as so
amended, the following new subsection shall be added, namely;
"(3) If, at
the time of entering upon office, an official residence is not available,. the
Leader of the Opposition shall, until such residence is provided by Government,
be paid actual expenses incurred by him on hiring a furnished accommodation for
himself and his family subject to a maximum of sixteen thousand rupees per
mensem.
(4) The official residence of the
Leader of the Opposition shall, subject to such conditions as may be imposed by
Government from time to time, be maintained by Government and shall be
furnished at a cost not exceeding one lac rupees.".
